selectedCaption: A plug from a gas-station kit is not a finished repair. It seals the hole. It doesn't seal the inside. Underneath, the inner liner stays open — that's where a slow leak starts. A real repair goes in from the inside — tire off the rim, patch sealed to the liner. A puncture near the sidewall isn't repairable — that tire gets replaced, not patched. Worth checking before you trust it at highway speed.
